tier2_explanatory.short_meaning: Son of the right hand; son of the south
tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Binyamin: ben, 'son', + yamin, 'right hand' or 'south'. Its root is Hebrew b-n + y-m-y-n. Benjamin, son of Jacob (Genesis 35:18). Benjamin is a Hebrew name meaning “Son of the right hand; son of the south”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
